screening.reason: Exclusion 3: uses only T1-weighted structural MRI scans from ABIDE (for a VAE-GAN image-harmonization method, with a structural-radiomic-feature ASD classification as an application test), with no resting-state functional analysis.

evidence_quotes: In our study, we only worked with anatomical T1-weighted images.
In total, 621 T1-weighted scans (309 patients and 312 controls) were collected.
